# 立体几何与空间向量：考点 22-28 全量本地题库

这一页把本地一轮复习资料中考点 22 到考点 28 的练习题按原考点完整整理出来。题干中的公式、图形和原 Word 图片会一起呈现；解析版内容折叠在“查看解析版原文”里，适合课后补充训练和查漏补缺。

返回专题首页：[立体几何与空间向量](./README.md)。精选入门题库：[立体几何与空间向量：图形题库](./02_solid_geometry_exercises_zh.md)。

## 使用说明

1. 这页是全量题库，不适合一次性布置完；课堂上先用精选题库建立方法，再从这里按考点抽题。
2. 学生讲题时，优先要求她说清楚“图形模型、目标类型、关键辅助线或坐标系”。
3. Word 中不少数学公式和空间图形本身就是图片，所以本页保留原图，避免抽文字时丢失关键信息。

## 考点 22：空间几何平行问题

本组来自 `考点22 空间几何平行问题（练习）（原卷版）.docx`；原卷共抽取 25 道题，解析版可对齐 25 道。

<p class="local-docx-line"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp23-a-146-c3070cc598.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="204" height="109"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】见解析</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】证明：过点C作CM⊥AB，垂足为M，因为AD⊥DC，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以四边形ADCM为矩形，所以AM＝MB＝2，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又AD＝2，AB＝4，所以AC＝2<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp23-a-147-28b1b80c7f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="40" height="43">，CM＝2，BC＝2<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp23-a-148-28b1b80c7f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="40" height="43">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以AC2＋BC2＝AB2，所以AC⊥BC，因为AF⊥平面ABCD，AF∥BE，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以BE⊥平面ABCD，所以BE⊥AC.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又BE⊂平面BCE，BC⊂平面BCE，且BE∩BC＝B，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以AC⊥平面BCE.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【题组二  面面垂直】</p>
</div>
:::

<p class="local-docx-line">（2）若<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-234-4149aeb8e7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="416">是棱<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-235-b60625895a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="576">的中点，求三棱锥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-236-f5581ac481.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1568" height="576">的体积与三棱柱<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-237-c60c0d91c7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2240" height="576">的体积之比.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】（1）见解析；（2）<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-238-2abaf0ee58.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="352" height="992"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-239-bc5e739fd8.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="197" height="125"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">（1）证明：连接AC1交A1C于点O，连接OD，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵CC1∥AA1，CC1＝AA1，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴四边形AA1C1C是平行四边形，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴O是AC1的中点，又D是AB的中点，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴OD∥BC1，又OD⊂平面A1CD，BC1⊄平面A1CD，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴BC1∥平面A1CD．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）设三棱柱A1B1C1﹣ABC的高为h，则三棱柱A1B1C1﹣ABC的体积V＝S△ABC•h，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又V＝V<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-240-2dbc9be093.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1440" height="608">V<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-241-bc334b58b1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="960" height="608">，V<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-242-de6e38e63b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1216" height="608">V<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-243-e681faa6b0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1536" height="992">S△ABC•h<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-244-7688c6614c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="736" height="992">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴V<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-245-4602dfc389.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2048" height="992">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵CC1∥BB1，CC1⊄平面ABB1A1，BB1⊂平面ABB1A1，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴CC1∥平面ABB1A1，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴V<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-246-3f24e491af.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1376" height="608">V<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-247-4602dfc389.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2048" height="992">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵S<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-248-b7b4581296.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1376" height="992">S<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-249-93238e6ee1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1920" height="640">，∴V<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-250-7206ac4b4a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1536" height="992">V<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-251-a6c8e37aaa.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3264" height="992">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴三棱锥C﹣AA1E的体积与三棱柱A1B1C1﹣ABC的体积之比为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-252-007d3ea32e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="352" height="992">．</p>

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-answer">
<p class="local-docx-line">1．如图，圆台<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-584-06eed8a2ad.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="576">的轴截面为等腰梯形<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-585-19c8bd17f1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1472" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-586-3a5795e782.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1728" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-587-50512ff873.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2080" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-588-cee468844c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1376" height="576">，圆台<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-589-06eed8a2ad.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="576">的侧面积为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-590-b906114d3e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="512" height="448">.若点C，D分别为圆<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-591-fab37fe84c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="480" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-592-57f5c3aa74.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="512" height="576">上的动点且点C，D在平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-593-19c8bd17f1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1472" height="576">的同侧.</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-594-39ca82e7fc.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="239" height="193"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">（1）求证：<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-595-72d0b0de20.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1760" height="576">；</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）若<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-596-576ffcafa9.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2272" height="576">，则当三棱锥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-597-62e748a114.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1664" height="576">的体积取最大值时，求多面体<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-598-f6da502c6a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1984" height="576">的体积.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】（1）证明见解析（2）<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-599-dab2923f7c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1472" height="992"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】（1）设<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-600-fab37fe84c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="480" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-601-57f5c3aa74.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="512" height="576">的半径分别为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-602-843545074b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="288" height="320">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-603-9cbace00be.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="480" height="416">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">因为圆台的侧面积为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-604-b906114d3e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="512" height="448">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-605-a9a43d647c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3456" height="992">，可得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-606-7716387827.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="800" height="416">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">因此，在等腰梯形<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-607-19c8bd17f1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1472" height="576">中，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-608-5f8aee92ca.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2688" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-609-cee468844c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1376" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-610-0946410f52.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1696" height="640">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">如图，连接线段<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-611-06eed8a2ad.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-612-933d884b31.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="512">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-613-6e02f16f43.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="768" height="576">，</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-614-ae25a60cbc.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="174" height="144"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">在圆台<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-615-06eed8a2ad.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="576">中，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-616-85d32d66a2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1216" height="576">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-617-9313cde0ba.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1024" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-618-44de60df0d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1088" height="576">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-619-9313cde0ba.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1024" height="576">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-620-001fd6529c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1888" height="576">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-621-241cad0183.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1248" height="576">，所以在<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-622-13956330ec.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1344" height="576">中，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-623-ed512593f3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1344" height="576">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">在<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-624-65d2ec6701.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1248" height="576">中，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-625-83b357ed9f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2144" height="992">，故<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-626-64b21a59f3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2208" height="576">，即<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-627-72d0b0de20.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1760" height="576">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）由题意可知，三棱锥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-628-62e748a114.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1664" height="576">的体积为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-629-6125c875bb.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="6304" height="1088">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又在直角三角形<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-630-6e1b6f1234.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1056" height="576">中，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-631-84313c514e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="6144" height="640">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以当且仅当<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-632-109c84795d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3104" height="672">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">即点D为弧<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-633-b00ac266fe.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="800" height="576">的中点时，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-634-5852b6f81c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1184" height="608">有最大值<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-635-fdfef5f937.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="1088">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">过点C作<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-636-f68985f439.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1856" height="576">交<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-637-25212e8339.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="800" height="576">于点M，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">因为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-638-85d32d66a2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1216" height="576">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-639-9313cde0ba.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1024" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-640-c4838f0869.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1120" height="448">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-641-9313cde0ba.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1024" height="576">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-642-6c28593271.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1920" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-643-0873c04e54.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1216" height="576">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-644-19c8bd17f1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1472" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-645-14af2f3781.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1216" height="576">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-646-19c8bd17f1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1472" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-647-a45a57f522.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2720" height="576">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-648-67e8c03b78.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1088" height="448">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-649-19c8bd17f1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1472" height="576">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-650-340e99b0f0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2272" height="576">，则点C到平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-651-19c8bd17f1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1472" height="576">的距离<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-652-9a093a116d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1664" height="1088">，</p>

### 题 53｜原题 2

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-question">
<p class="local-docx-line">2．在四棱锥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-q-172-67b0714e72.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1760" height="448">中，底面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-q-173-505254b4f2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="448">是边长为2的菱形，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-q-174-b99a926a53.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="6272" height="512">是<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-q-175-4903117669.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="416">的中点．</p>

<p class="local-docx-line">（2）<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-734-92ee052543.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="512" height="416">为线段<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-735-f72cc3b48c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="448">上一动点，当直线<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-736-a7b1dd03f6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="800" height="416">与平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-737-9057cca70b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="448">所成的角最大时，求三棱锥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-738-5ed186bbe4.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1664" height="448">外接球的体积.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】（1）<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-739-421efa43d6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="864" height="1088">.（2）<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-740-0aba804748.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1280" height="1088"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】解法一：（1）设<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-741-ef34cb6bc9.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="416" height="416">为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-742-f72cc3b48c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="448">中点，连接<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-743-e885548455.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">､<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-744-d39e4535c2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="416">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-745-680e646e8a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1088" height="448">为等腰直角三角形，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">且二面角<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-746-01e34892b0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1856" height="448">为直二面角，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-747-ca22851633.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="992" height="416">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-748-2a18b3ec28.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="928" height="448"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-749-9017d9d5c4.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3616" height="544">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-750-f52a4978d4.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2624" height="416">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">由平面几何可知，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-751-58c74a010f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2560" height="576">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-752-21b24db030.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1600" height="448">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-753-f9a419be69.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1600" height="448">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-754-fef0e14492.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1056" height="448">就是二面角<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-755-f8c0c607c5.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1856" height="448">的平面角，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">在<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-756-4c83db9f44.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1184" height="448">中，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-757-9ca7091306.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1504" height="544">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-758-4047880b56.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3456" height="640">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-759-ed0c49cebd.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3072" height="576">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-760-c9e0c67f37.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="7296" height="1120">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴二面角<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-761-f8c0c607c5.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1856" height="448">的余弦值为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-762-421efa43d6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="864" height="1088">.</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-763-3cd2be980e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="163" height="151"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）设直线<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-764-a7b1dd03f6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="800" height="416">与平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-765-9057cca70b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="448">所成的角为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-766-b9589b5df2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="352">，点<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-767-9fd69941b2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="416" height="416">到平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-768-9057cca70b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="448">的距离为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-769-60db2e4a3c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="352" height="448">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-770-b6d8cf35f3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1984" height="992">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">在三棱锥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-771-3a363526fa.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1504" height="448">中，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-772-3faa22a7b4.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4416" height="992">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">由<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-773-faae8fbff6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3712" height="608">，求得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-774-da719b12b1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1472" height="1088">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴当<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-775-a7b1dd03f6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="800" height="416">最小时，直线<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-776-a7b1dd03f6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="800" height="416">与平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-777-9057cca70b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="448">所成的角的正弦值最大，此时所成角也最大，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴当<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-778-92ee052543.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="512" height="416">为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-779-f72cc3b48c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="448">中点时，直线<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-780-a7b1dd03f6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="800" height="416">与平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-781-9057cca70b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="448">所成的角最大，此时<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-782-cf46a5db5c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1376" height="416">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">由平面几何知识可知，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-783-6abbaa410e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1248" height="448">和<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-784-8b38687c84.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1280" height="448">都是直角三角形，设<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-785-a1eeb0e1c6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="448" height="448">为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-786-26ae642e7f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="448">的中点，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-787-9a3b65bca4.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="5888" height="1088">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴三棱锥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-788-5ed186bbe4.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1664" height="448">外接球的半径为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-789-0849a86c47.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="800" height="1088">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴外接球的体积<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-790-b558a72c6f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4128" height="1344">.</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-791-59c6d8bd71.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="175" height="166"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">解法二：（1）∵<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-792-680e646e8a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1088" height="448">为等腰直角三角形，且二面角<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-793-01e34892b0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1856" height="448">为直二面角，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-794-ca22851633.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="992" height="416">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-795-2a18b3ec28.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="928" height="448">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-796-02677ab559.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1600" height="448">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-797-9fd69941b2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="416" height="416">为坐标原点，以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-798-b7d76bdde2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">､<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-799-19638d559f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="704" height="448">､<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-800-c6cbebb1e9.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">所在直线为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-801-d5351099ec.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="320" height="352">轴､<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-802-f528bdf372.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="352" height="416">轴､<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-803-c1acf60c9f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="288" height="288">轴建立如图所示的空间直角坐标系.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵在平面图形中，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-804-680e646e8a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1088" height="448">是斜边为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-805-28e0b53283.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="800" height="544">的等腰直角三角形，且<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-806-4149aeb8e7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="416">为高<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-807-18dc66aafe.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="416">的中点，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-808-4d6b70f517.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1536" height="512">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-809-0fa06908ca.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1728" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-810-76b4c83767.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1984" height="608">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-811-12e4f6673b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1984" height="608">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-812-c42f4f7178.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1792" height="608">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-813-8cdd73d48c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3360" height="608">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-814-af14257b37.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3328" height="608">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-815-112879da03.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3136" height="608">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">设平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-816-1c61998676.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="448">的一个法向量为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-817-4ddafea60b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2240" height="672">，平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-818-9057cca70b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="448">的一个法向量为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-819-877827ee2c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2272" height="672">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">由<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-820-bb863e4bbb.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1888" height="1216">，得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-821-3d0eb00f91.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3392" height="1344">，令<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-822-d08c0920ab.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="928" height="576">，则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-823-44a5edc2fa.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1632" height="576"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-824-a7d7124cc3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1696" height="608">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">同理可求得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-825-c265a6297b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1834" height="670">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-826-2b72e40f7e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="5632" height="1152">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴二面角<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-827-f8c0c607c5.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1856" height="448">的余弦值为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-828-421efa43d6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="864" height="1088">.</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-829-16a841c0ca.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="239" height="215"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）如图，设<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-830-c99eca69c6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3264" height="512">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">可得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-831-f3e9637266.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4064" height="608">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-832-bb97f00a8a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4736" height="608">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又由（1）可知平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-833-9057cca70b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="448">的法向量为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-834-c265a6297b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1834" height="670">，∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-835-0655eaa2bc.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="8960" height="1280">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">即直线<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-836-a7b1dd03f6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="800" height="416">与平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-837-9057cca70b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="448">所成的角的正弦值为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-838-7d9f0bcb00.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3072" height="1184">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-839-f27aae405f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1184" height="480">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-840-4ab7490068.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3968" height="1280">，当且仅当<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-841-737a164b5d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="896">时，等号成立.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴当<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-842-92ee052543.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="512" height="416">为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-843-f72cc3b48c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="448">中点时，直线<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-844-a7b1dd03f6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="800" height="416">与平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-845-9057cca70b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="448">所成的角最大，此时<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-846-cf46a5db5c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1376" height="416">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">由平面几何知识可知，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-847-6abbaa410e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1248" height="448">和<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-848-8b38687c84.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1280" height="448">都是直角三角形，设<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-849-a1eeb0e1c6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="448" height="448">为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-850-26ae642e7f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="448">的中点，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-851-9a3b65bca4.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="5888" height="1088">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴三棱锥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-852-5ed186bbe4.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1664" height="448">外接球的半径为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-853-0849a86c47.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="800" height="1088">，</p>

<p class="local-docx-line">（Ⅱ）<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-886-9033bce83c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2624" height="576">，则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-887-eb24fe5eab.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1696" height="576">.<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-888-fd5a0d25a9.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2016" height="512">，即<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-889-a9d1541f83.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1600" height="448">.又<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-890-bfcaea4528.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2176" height="480">，所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-891-05781352c6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2944" height="576">，故<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-892-d46100763a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3072" height="576">，所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-893-cffa700d45.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1216" height="576">是直角三角形.</p>

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-answer">
<p class="local-docx-line">5．现需要设计一个仓库，它由上下两部分组成，上部分的形状是正四棱锥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-910-8902914e53.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2048" height="576">，下部分的形状是正四棱柱<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-911-733ad3183f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2848" height="576">（如图所示），并要求正四棱柱的高<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-912-bf6cfd2d70.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="736" height="576">是正四棱锥的高<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-913-ba83fc3485.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="512">的4倍.</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-914-e7b1376e75.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="153" height="150"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">（1）若<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-915-fa6de1cb40.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3296" height="576">则仓库的容积是多少？</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）若正四棱锥的侧棱长为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-916-b05903ad04.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="512">，则当<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-917-ba83fc3485.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="512">为多少时，仓库的容积最大？</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】（1）312（2）<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-918-dd97a175da.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1792" height="640"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】（1）由PO1=2知OO1=4PO1=8.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">因为A1B1=AB=6，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以正四棱锥P-A1B1C1D1的体积<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-919-c62fbf9b9e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="6336" height="992"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">正四棱柱ABCD-A1B1C1D1的体积<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-920-e07a4e4968.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="5312" height="704"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以仓库的容积V=V锥+V柱=24+288=312（m3）.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）设A1B1=a（m），PO1=h（m），则0&lt;h&lt;6，OO1=4h.连结O1B1.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">因为在<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-921-cdcdaa5b83.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="704" height="448"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-922-373f9e8454.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1024" height="576">中，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-923-52b64c1f84.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3168" height="608"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-924-f3a69eebc6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2816" height="1088">，即<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-925-30917bec26.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2560" height="704"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">于是仓库的容积<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-926-f7e21a3c01.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="10176" height="992">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">从而<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-927-36458c1de3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="5056" height="992">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">令<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-928-9b44788f25.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1056" height="448">，得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-929-8a3a9d79c3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1376" height="576">或<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-930-0335b1971e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1568" height="576">（舍）.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">当<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-931-6dcaf94a2b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1920" height="576">时，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-932-2e9d9f55e1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1056" height="448">，V是单调增函数；</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">当<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-933-93383a399f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1920" height="576">时，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-934-449170dd2d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1056" height="448">，V是单调减函数.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">故<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-935-8a3a9d79c3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1376" height="576">时，V取得极大值，也是最大值.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">因此，当<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-936-dd97a175da.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1792" height="640">m时，仓库的容积最大.</p>
</div>
:::

:::

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-answer">
<p class="local-docx-line">6．如图，在四棱锥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-937-67b0714e72.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1760" height="448">中，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-938-ab37c252f6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="416"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-939-383fe66316.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="416">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-940-505254b4f2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="448">, <img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-941-218e92fb9a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1440" height="384">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-942-55fb363e5a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1440" height="416">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-943-e625b96d66.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2368" height="448">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-944-bfaffd018b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1664" height="544">,<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-945-92ee052543.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="512" height="416">是线段<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-946-0823c4c1c7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">的中点.</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-947-7e26aff24a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="168" height="156"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">（1）证明：<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-948-78b502eb81.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1216" height="480">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-949-f5e951acaf.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="448"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-950-1913d46f9d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="192" height="416"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）当<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-951-ab37c252f6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="416">为何值时，四棱锥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-952-67b0714e72.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1760" height="448">的体积最大？并求此最大值</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】（1）见解析（2）当PA＝4时，体积最大值为16．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】（1）取PD中点N，连接MN，CN，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵M是AP的中点，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴MN∥AD且MN<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-953-4eb5a52d24.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1280" height="992">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵AD∥BC，AD＝2BC，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴MN∥BC，MN＝BC，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴四边形MNCB是平行四边形，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴MB∥CN，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又BM<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-954-7d7dad9adc.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="384">平面PCD，CN⊂平面PCD，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴BM∥平面PCD；</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）设PA＝x（0＜x＜4<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-955-8c058981a3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="544">），</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵PA⊥平面ABCD，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴PA⊥AB，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-956-59a913f5b8.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1664" height="544">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴AB<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-957-726aab10e9.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4128" height="640">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又∵AB⊥AD，AD＝2BC＝4，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴VP﹣ABCD<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-958-06bf1fc9f3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2336" height="992"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-959-3774743612.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4544" height="992"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-960-2babd4fec2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1984" height="640"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-961-130d1b91a0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2240" height="1056"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">＝16，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">当且仅当x<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-962-aede299b2c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1792" height="640">，即x＝4时取等号，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">故当PA＝4时，四棱锥P﹣ABCD的体积最大，最大值为16．</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-963-1f0e0b4c52.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="221" height="222"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">【题组五 历史中的空间几何体】</p>
</div>
:::

### 题 58｜原题 1

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-question">
<p class="local-docx-line">1．朱世杰是元代著名的数学家，有“中世纪世界最伟大的数学家”之称.其著作《四元玉鉴》是一部成就辉煌的数学名著，受到数学史研究者的高度评价.《四元玉鉴》下卷“杂范类会”中第一问为：“今有沈香立圆球一只，径十寸，今从顶截周八寸四分，问厚几何？”大意为现有一个直径为10的球，从上面截一小部分，截面圆周长为8.4，问被截取部分几何体的高为多少.已知朱世杰是以圆周率为3来计算，则《四元玉鉴》中此题答案为（    ）（注：<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-q-238-31b05f34a0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2016" height="512">）</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">A．0.2B．0.4C．0.6D．0.8</p>
</div>
:::

:::solution 查看解析版原文

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-answer">
<p class="local-docx-line">1．朱世杰是元代著名的数学家，有“中世纪世界最伟大的数学家”之称.其著作《四元玉鉴》是一部成就辉煌的数学名著，受到数学史研究者的高度评价.《四元玉鉴》下卷“杂范类会”中第一问为：“今有沈香立圆球一只，径十寸，今从顶截周八寸四分，问厚几何？”大意为现有一个直径为10的球，从上面截一小部分，截面圆周长为8.4，问被截取部分几何体的高为多少.已知朱世杰是以圆周率为3来计算，则《四元玉鉴》中此题答案为（    ）（注：<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-964-31b05f34a0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2016" height="512">）</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">A．0.2B．0.4C．0.6D．0.8</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】A</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】设截面圆半径为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-965-843545074b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="288" height="320">，截下来的几何体高为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-966-7fd461a5ab.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="320" height="448">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">若以3作为圆周率，则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-967-fb72158f78.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2208" height="992">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-968-90c9da482b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2656" height="704">，故<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp24-a-969-f254e48487.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="7104" height="640">，故选：A.</p>
</div>
:::

### 题 59｜原题 2

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-question">
<p class="local-docx-line">2．鲁班锁（也称孔明锁、难人木、六子联方）起源于古代中国建筑的榫卯结构.这种三维的拼插器具内部的凹凸部分（即榫卯结构）啮合，十分巧妙.鲁班锁类玩具比较多，形状和内部的构造各不相同，一般都是易拆难装.如图1，这是一种常见的鲁班锁玩具，图2是该鲁班锁玩具的直观图，每条棱的长均为2，则该鲁班锁的表面积为（    ）</p>

:::solution 查看解析版原文

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-answer">
<p class="local-docx-line">6．如图，在底面为正方形的四棱锥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-143-67b0714e72.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1760" height="448">中，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-144-67ac47f0e0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4768" height="448">，点<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-145-4149aeb8e7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="416">为棱<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-146-ab37c252f6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="416">的中点，则异面直线<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-147-7f3bbb245a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="576" height="384">与<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-148-b1c7452efd.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">所成角的余弦值为___________</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-149-ef8c27e987.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="183" height="131"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-150-3926ecfaff.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="1120"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-151-2a15e0690a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="222" height="168"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">取PD的中点记为F点，BC的中点记为 点，连接FG，GD，因为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-152-cfaba7d8cb.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1280" height="448">，且<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-153-d4f428d960.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1856" height="992">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-154-508fc36293.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1856" height="992">，故得到四边形EFGB为平行四边形，故角GFD或其补角为所求角，根据题干得到，三角形PAB为等边三角形，BF为其高线，长度为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-155-4866d37b8f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="576" height="576">，FG=<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-156-4866d37b8f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="576" height="576">，DG=<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-157-55e1a33b9f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3008" height="640">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">FD=1，根据余弦定理得到<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-158-cb7fa99921.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4512" height="1152">，因为异面直线夹角为直角或锐角，故取正值，为：<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-159-c19dfc4bb7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="1088">.故答案为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-160-c19dfc4bb7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="1088">.</p>
</div>
:::

### 题 72｜原题 6

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-question">
<p class="local-docx-line">6．如图，在几何体P﹣ABCD中，平面ABCD⊥平面PAB ，四边形ABCD为矩形，△PAB为正三角形，若AB＝2，AD＝1，E，F 分别为AC，BP中点．</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-q-100-8a424852cb.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="429" height="386"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">（1）求证：EF∥平面PCD；</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）求直线DP与平面ABCD所成角的正弦值．</p>
</div>
:::

:::solution 查看解析版原文

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-answer">
<p class="local-docx-line">6．如图，在几何体P﹣ABCD中，平面ABCD⊥平面PAB ，四边形ABCD为矩形，△PAB为正三角形，若AB＝2，AD＝1，E，F 分别为AC，BP中点．</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-436-8a424852cb.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="429" height="386"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">（1）求证：EF∥平面PCD；</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）求直线DP与平面ABCD所成角的正弦值．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】(1)见证明；(2) <img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-437-2ad50f1c8d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="800" height="1088"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】(1)因为E为AC中点，所以DB与AC交于点E．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">因为E，F分别为AC，BP中点，所以EF是△BDP的中位线，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以EF∥DP．又DP⊂平面PCD，EF⊄平面PCD，所以EF∥平面PCD．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">(2)取AB中点O,连接PO，DO</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-438-1b9d279012.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="364" height="328"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵△PAB为正三角形，∴PO⊥AB，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又∵平面ABCD⊥平面PAB</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴PO⊥平面ABCD,∴DP在平面ABCD内的射影为DO，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∠PDO为DP与平面ABCD所成角，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-439-d4851185dd.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3008" height="608"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">在Rt△DOP中，sin∠PDO=<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-440-64835aa3ed.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2720" height="1152">,</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴直线DP与平面ABCD所成角的正弦值为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-441-2ad50f1c8d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="800" height="1088"></p>
</div>
:::

:::

<p class="local-docx-line">3．如图，在四棱锥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-696-aae91a7775.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1568" height="416">中，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-697-d16d103b4a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="448">底面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-698-505254b4f2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="448">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-699-505254b4f2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="448">是边长为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-700-bb93cdeecd.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="224" height="416">的正方形．且<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-701-0d3673eb4f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1056" height="448">，点<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-702-92ee052543.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="512" height="416">是<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-703-81eaddea6f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="448">的中点．</p>

<p class="local-docx-line">（1）求证：<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-705-2a7f6eff45.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1696" height="448">；</p>

### 题 80｜原题 4

<p class="local-docx-line">4．已知四棱锥P－ABCD的三视图如下图所示，E是侧棱PC上的动点．</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-q-163-f87f7b6519.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="175" height="164"></div>

:::solution 查看解析版原文

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-answer">
<p class="local-docx-line">4．已知四棱锥P－ABCD的三视图如下图所示，E是侧棱PC上的动点．</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-792-f87f7b6519.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="175" height="164"></div>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-793-741351357f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="294" height="132"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">（1）求证：BD⊥AE</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）若点E为PC的中点，求二面角D－AE－B的大小.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】（1）证明见解析；（2）<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-794-af18063807.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="992">．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】（1）由三视图可知，四棱锥P－ABCD的底面是边长为1的正方形，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">侧棱PC⊥底面ABCD，且PC＝2.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">连结AC，∵ABCD是正方形， ∴BD⊥AC.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵PC⊥底面ABCD，且BD⊂平面ABCD， ∴BD⊥PC.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又∵AC∩PC＝C，∴BD⊥平面PAC.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵AE⊂平面PAC. ∴BD⊥AE.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）解法1：在平面DAE内过点D作DF⊥AE于F，连结BF.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵AD＝AB＝1，DE＝BE＝<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-795-7e65f48574.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="80" height="23">，AE＝AE＝<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-796-aa52291db1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="24" height="24">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴Rt△ADE≌Rt△ABE，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">从而△ADF≌△ABF，∴BF⊥AE.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴∠DFB为二面角D－AE－B的平面角．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">在Rt△ADE中，DF＝<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-797-9a0354c2d8.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="160" height="48">， ∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-798-160beeb0ad.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="67" height="45">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又BD＝<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-799-5c9df7ea1c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="25" height="23">，在△DFB中，由余弦定理得</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">cos∠DFB＝<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-800-ddab41fb26.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3872" height="1056">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴∠DFB＝<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-801-8244ae4c5b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="27" height="41">，即二面角D－AE－B的大小为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-802-8244ae4c5b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="27" height="41"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">解法2：如图，以点C为原点，CD，CB，CP所在的直线分别为x，y，z轴建立空间直角坐标系．则D（1,0,0），A（1,1,0），B（0,1,0），E（0,0,1），</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-803-ab55904351.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="144" height="168"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">从而<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-804-80df424a6c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="27" height="23">＝（0,1,0），<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-805-7a725fbdf6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="28" height="23">＝（－1,0,1），<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-806-1bd9395009.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="25" height="23">＝（1,0,0），<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-807-db7775a4b8.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="25" height="23">＝（0，－1,1）．[Z#x设平面ADE和平面ABE的法向量分别为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-808-07963ad6b2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2272" height="672">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-809-c617daa2a6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2432" height="672"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">由<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-810-d54a250851.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1856" height="1280"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-811-d26cf8d95b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2432" height="1152">，取<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-812-d73206e652.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1792" height="672"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">由<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-813-855f70353f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1856" height="1280"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-814-ab7890833f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2528" height="1152">，取<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-815-944e05c71a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2336" height="672"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">设二面角D－AE－B的平面角为θ，则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-816-99b73284c9.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4928" height="1344">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴θ＝<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-817-8244ae4c5b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="27" height="41">，即二面角D－AE－B的大小为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp25-a-818-8244ae4c5b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="27" height="41"></p>

<p class="local-docx-line">1．如图，在△ABC中，D，E分别为AB，AC的中点，O为DE的中点，AB=AC=2<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-189-8e5bc36bc2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="576" height="576">，BC=4．将△ADE沿DE折起到△A1DE的位置，使得平面A1DE<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-190-383fe66316.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="416">平面BCED，如下图．</p>

<p class="local-docx-line">故可得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-197-1017fc4024.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1568" height="416">，故<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-198-ad749e04bd.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1280" height="576">为等腰三角形，又<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-199-ad2c0fbebb.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="448">为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-200-db15fd43ac.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="416">中点，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">故可得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-201-57fe9ac64f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1696" height="576">，又因为平面A1DE<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-202-383fe66316.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="416">平面BCED，且交线为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-203-db15fd43ac.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="416">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-204-58c535e064.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1088" height="576">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-205-6fb5a5653d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="992" height="576">，故<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-206-3a8d4e3d86.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1056" height="576">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-207-dfa0a36f4e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="448">，又<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-208-1baa795e11.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1024" height="416">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-209-2463e8bf62.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1408" height="448">，</p>

### 题 94｜原题 4

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-question">

:::solution 查看解析版原文

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-answer">
<p class="local-docx-line">4．如图，在直三棱柱ABC﹣A1B1C1中，△ABC是边长为6的等边三角形，D，E分别为AA1，BC的中点．</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-399-28309dfd70.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="292" height="275"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">（1）证明：AE//平面BDC1；</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）若异面直线BC1与AC所成角的余弦值为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-400-6146827c3d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="1088">．求DE与平面BDC1所成角的正弦值．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】（1）详见解析；（2）<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-401-bea8cbae94.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="1088">．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】（1）证明：取BC1的中点F，连接DF，EF，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵E为BC中点，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-402-e885548455.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">∥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-403-349dd38305.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="512">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-404-a76b667d03.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1920" height="992"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又∵D为AA1的中点，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-405-b7d76bdde2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">∥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-406-349dd38305.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="512">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-407-fb0a89f729.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1920" height="992">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-408-e885548455.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">∥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-409-b7d76bdde2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-410-e885548455.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-411-148b4128c1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="928" height="416"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴四边形ADFE为平行四边形，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴AE∥DF，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵AE<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-412-7d7dad9adc.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="384">平面BDC1，DF<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-413-dcfd84c9ba.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="320">平面BDC1，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴AE∥平面BDC1；</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）由（1）及题设可知，BC，EA，EF两两互相垂直，则以点E为坐标原点，EC，EA，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">EF所在直线分别为x轴，y轴，z轴建立如图所示的空间直角坐标系，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">设AA1＝2t（t＞0），则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-414-2e180e5958.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="8704" height="640">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-415-2f633d65e7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="7648" height="640">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">故<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-416-75ad9aad70.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="10688" height="1344"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">解得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-417-6eac406b8b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1088" height="576">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">设平面BDC1的法向量为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-418-a47f7e2737.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1920" height="608"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">由<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-419-94917d3e0a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1984" height="1280">，得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-420-8f901f9835.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3392" height="1344">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">令<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-421-70091f91a4.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="448">，则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-422-9d47519eaf.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2304" height="608">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-423-e9f04a6b6d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="5408" height="608">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-424-ddb9d44b1a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="10464" height="1312">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">设DE与平面BDC1所成角为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-425-60668bd80f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="320" height="448">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-426-aee50f6f80.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="448"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-427-6b1cce1c22.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3456" height="1088">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴DE与平面BDC1所成角的正弦值为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-428-bea8cbae94.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="1088">.</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-429-3930f1b27a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="274" height="221"></div>
</div>
:::

<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-441-7c80e44303.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="242" height="182"></div>

<p class="local-docx-line">又因为平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-522-2f35e2d556.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1504" height="448">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-523-81eb2ffd83.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="992" height="384">，平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-524-3aff4bd609.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1504" height="448">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-525-baa9359ba2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2016" height="416">，</p>

<p class="local-docx-line">如图，建立空间直角坐标系<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-530-5210690ff3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2304" height="768">，则</p>

<p class="local-docx-line">由（1）可知，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-613-93322e7be2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="992" height="416">面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-614-505254b4f2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="448">，取平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-615-505254b4f2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="448">的法向量<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-616-f144414961.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2144" height="608"></p>
