<p class="local-docx-line">根据图形，二面角<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-618-9384f9bee0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1856" height="448">的平面角的余弦值为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-619-b31d1f212f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="1088"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以二面角<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-620-9384f9bee0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1856" height="448">的平面角的正切值为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-621-fbe810a1e5.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="544">；</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（3）<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-622-099b45f883.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2112" height="608">，由（2）可得平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-623-021237beee.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="416">的法向量<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-624-645b70e17c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1856" height="608"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">设直线<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-625-d28a4b1ac3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">与平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-626-021237beee.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="416">所成的角为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-627-60668bd80f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="320" height="448">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-628-af8796dc4c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="5504" height="1184">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-629-d28a4b1ac3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">与平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-630-021237beee.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="416">所成的角的正弦值<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-631-b31d1f212f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="1088">.</p>

<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-answer">
<p class="local-docx-line">3．如图四棱柱<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-632-d5d3fd3107.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2848" height="576">中，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-633-55fb363e5a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1440" height="416">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-634-218e92fb9a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1440" height="384">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-635-6604656e28.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2688" height="448">，M为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-636-3ce21cbd26.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="736" height="576">的中点.</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-637-0d62549a3e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="154" height="131"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">（1）证明：<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-638-c468b3245d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1120" height="448">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-639-b91a7df20b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1248" height="576">；</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）若四边形<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-640-b91a7df20b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1248" height="576">是菱形，且面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-641-90428e1a9d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1600" height="576">面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-642-505254b4f2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="448">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-643-65565cdc9c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1888" height="992">，求二面角<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-644-3be4d78553.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2016" height="576">的余弦值.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】（1）证明见解析；（2）<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-645-e287058dcd.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="992">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】（1）取<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-646-7c17988515.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="576">的中点N，连接<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-647-cd48b13cb1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="736" height="448">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-648-4ddafbae95.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="740" height="493">，</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-649-b3a5295096.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1139" height="995"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵M为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-650-3ce21cbd26.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="736" height="576">的中点，∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-651-8677e457b0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1696" height="448">且<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-652-96f2bcb69b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1984" height="992"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-653-707adadbe4.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1440" height="416">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-654-a19ca32422.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1888" height="992"> ，所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-655-ba3a9e4179.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1696" height="448">且<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-656-f3e1b668ab.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1664" height="448">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以四边形<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-657-527d2926b1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1216" height="448">是平行四边形，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">从而<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-658-913930eaff.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1696" height="448">，又<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-659-75056eea7e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1024" height="448">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-660-b91a7df20b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1248" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-661-d147953366.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1120" height="448">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-662-b91a7df20b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1248" height="576">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-663-c468b3245d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1120" height="448">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-664-b91a7df20b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1248" height="576">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）取<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-665-223067fb17.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="768" height="576">的中点P，连接<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-666-0823c4c1c7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-667-9e87c270b7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="576">，</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-668-d08a4a8eca.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1139" height="995"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵四边形<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-669-b91a7df20b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1248" height="576">为菱形，又<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-670-65565cdc9c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1888" height="992">，易知<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-671-f4b5451f40.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1568" height="416">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-672-90428e1a9d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1600" height="576">面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-673-505254b4f2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="448">，面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-674-9ca9e54bca.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1568" height="576">面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-675-db66d6059c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2048" height="448">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-676-a874f412a8.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1763" height="458"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-677-ade9858436.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1024" height="416">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-678-b91a7df20b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1248" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-679-9e79c69e4f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1600" height="416"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">故<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-680-d28a4b1ac3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-681-18dc66aafe.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="416">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-682-0823c4c1c7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">两两垂直</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">以A为原点，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-683-d28a4b1ac3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-684-18dc66aafe.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="416">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-685-0823c4c1c7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">所在直线分别为x，y，z轴建立空间直角坐标系<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-686-f24e907e1a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1248" height="512">（如图所示），不妨设<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-687-fb9676a305.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1216" height="416">.</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-688-29bca8aa8b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="411" height="359"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-689-35620f8237.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1568" height="640">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-690-4623665d0d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1600" height="640">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-691-e0421dddeb.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1568" height="640">，，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-692-f440feb006.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2336" height="768">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-693-484a5e5995.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2144" height="768">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-694-5090e06ab2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2784" height="768">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-695-ee0f8b1da7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2752" height="768">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-696-943d37f52d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2176" height="672"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">设平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-697-6a7554a41f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1088" height="576">的法向量为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-698-498964ec70.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1952" height="672">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">由<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-699-e455330ab7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2080" height="1216">，得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-700-a3636973cc.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2816" height="1344">，</p>

<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】(1) <img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-799-b31d1f212f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="1088"> (2)<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-800-e8855a4611.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="768" height="960"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-801-3d76198661.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="95" height="32">为正交基底建立如图所示的空间直角坐标系<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-802-d281602fd8.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="512">，则各点的坐标为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-803-71752990de.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="6240" height="640">．</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-804-f6675edcf0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="146" height="151"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">（1） 因为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-805-ade9858436.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1024" height="416">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-806-f4baa4f0cf.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="416">，所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-807-726f3a2d34.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="28" height="21">是平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-808-f4baa4f0cf.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="416">的一个法向量，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-809-99305363a9.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="91" height="28">．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">因为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-810-0b17b0d397.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4576" height="608">．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">设平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-811-f5e951acaf.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="448">的法向量为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-812-498964ec70.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1952" height="672">，则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-813-29b8a2b04a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3392" height="608">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">即<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-814-0c778cecee.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2304" height="1088">，令<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-815-ae6d4a929a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="512">，解得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-816-e53a4f228f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1664" height="512">．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-817-33ff6a0eb3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1728" height="672">是平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-818-f5e951acaf.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="448">的一个法向量，从而<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-819-feeeb146a5.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4608" height="1184">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-820-f4baa4f0cf.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="416">与平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-821-f5e951acaf.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="448">所成二面角的余弦值为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-822-b31d1f212f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="1088">．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2） 因为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-823-6fc7b848d0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2016" height="576">，设<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-824-a4a4f66b11.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="5408" height="608">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-825-18002aa727.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2272" height="608">，则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-826-5dd6dbefc2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4576" height="608">，</p>

<p class="local-docx-line">从而<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-828-41bcc177e9.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="6208" height="1216">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">设<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-829-3ea5030669.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2816" height="640">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-830-43942e2984.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="8064" height="1728">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">当且仅当<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-831-b0f5e726db.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="864" height="992">，即<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-832-6d340c038d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="992" height="992">时，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-833-64585d056f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2368" height="608">的最大值为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-834-08bbd4dcba.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="864" height="960">．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">因为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-835-b3e5485650.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1472" height="416">在<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-836-a3c2eca785.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1120" height="1088">上是减函数，此时直线<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-837-afbe48398b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="512">与<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-838-6c1e62da52.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">所成角取得最小值．</p>

### 题 101｜原题 6

<p class="local-docx-line">6．如图，在三棱锥S一ABC中，SA＝AB＝AC＝BC＝<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-q-183-8c058981a3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="544">SB＝<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-q-184-8c058981a3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="544">SC，O为BC的中点</p>

<p class="local-docx-line">（2）在线段AB上是否存在一点E，使二面角B—SC－E的平面角的余弦值为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-q-185-ab8b34ce5f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="1088">？若存在，求<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-q-186-2a369166ae.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="704" height="992">的值，若不存在，试说明理由</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-q-187-d979b327ba.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="130" height="123"></div>

:::solution 查看解析版原文

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-answer">
<p class="local-docx-line">6．如图，在三棱锥S一ABC中，SA＝AB＝AC＝BC＝<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-841-8c058981a3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="544">SB＝<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-842-8c058981a3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="544">SC，O为BC的中点</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（1）求证：SO⊥平面ABC</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）在线段AB上是否存在一点E，使二面角B—SC－E的平面角的余弦值为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-843-ab8b34ce5f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="1088">？若存在，求<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-844-2a369166ae.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="704" height="992">的值，若不存在，试说明理由</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-845-d979b327ba.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="130" height="123"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】（1）见解析（2）<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-846-5c173f1b85.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="992"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】（1）∵<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-847-1783385b05.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1440" height="448">，O为BC的中点，∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-848-43f00992cb.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1568" height="448">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">设<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-849-04ee440f8c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="448">，则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-850-d5934b493e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1792" height="1088">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-851-ee8e08c737.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1856" height="1088">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-852-fa93181d71.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1600" height="544">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-853-1fc15f520e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2720" height="512">，∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-854-351a386bd9.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1536" height="448">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又∵<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-855-eef9b4a26b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2208" height="448">，∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-856-bd4fdaef91.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="960" height="448">平面ABC．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）以O为原点，以OA所在射线为x轴正半轴，以OB所在射线为y轴正半轴，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">以OS所在射线为z轴正半轴建立空间直角坐标系．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">则有<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-857-34a48b334f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1568" height="640">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-858-b21eaa27a5.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2144" height="1280">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-859-d7f269cc34.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2528" height="1280">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-860-2ab5c279b6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2240" height="1280">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-861-df20966d63.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2240" height="1280">．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">假设存在点E满足条件，设<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-862-713bd9c89a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3360" height="672">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-863-712ffe998e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4160" height="1280">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-864-4ae76e0012.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4800" height="1280">．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">设平面SCE的法向量为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-865-592018204f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1888" height="640">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">由<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-866-1ee521222c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1792" height="1216">，得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-867-fab613765d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3424" height="1280">，故可取<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-868-0f2b99afb4.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3584" height="768">．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">易得平面SBC的一个法向量为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-869-00d8718a9a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1856" height="640">．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-870-b171960acc.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="5952" height="1216">，解得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-871-941bc09b0e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="992" height="992">或<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-872-ab5f478e84.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="448">（舍）．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以，当<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-873-5ebd6acdb1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1312" height="992">时，二面角<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-874-0254a25880.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1792" height="448">的余弦值为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-875-ab8b34ce5f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="1088">．</p>

<p class="local-docx-line">（Ⅲ）已知点<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-888-5a24cd24db.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="416" height="384">在棱<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-889-a2dd2b41db.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">上，且异面直线<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-890-66be5cd2cc.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="704" height="416">与<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-891-4903117669.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="416">所成角的余弦值为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-892-bf0dfcfc39.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="1088">，求线段<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-893-3e77b99ca5.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="736" height="416">的长．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】（1）证明见解析；（2）<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-894-41c8117165.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="544" height="896">；（3）<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-895-12c86dbc99.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="992">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】（1）<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-896-8181bcb71e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="352" height="320">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-897-437d6d4cd4.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1536" height="512">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-898-d110b76d34.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="448">，</p>

<p class="local-docx-line"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-902-1a58eb3021.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2880" height="544">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-903-6a21daf95b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1632" height="416">，</p>

<p class="local-docx-line">由题意，以点<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-907-9fd69941b2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="416" height="416">为原点，分别以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-908-d4db554cf3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2016" height="608">的方向为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-909-d5351099ec.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="320" height="352">轴，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-910-f528bdf372.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="352" height="416">轴，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-911-c1acf60c9f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="288" height="288">轴的正向建立如图空间直角坐标系，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">则可得：<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp26-a-912-606fa7c449.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4832" height="640">，</p>

<p class="local-docx-line">而<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-065-96380ed787.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4352" height="576">，故<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-066-4e4d0e4058.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1472" height="480">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">而四边形<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-067-3dd5465eaa.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="512">一定是平行四边形，故它还是菱形，即点<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-068-4149aeb8e7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="416">一定是<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-069-a009055a69.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="768" height="576">的中点，</p>

<p class="local-docx-line">1．已知正方体ABCD ­A1B1C1D1的棱长为2，点E是A1B1的中点，则点A到直线BE的距离是(　　)</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">A．<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-092-9aabd66a4a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="1088">B．<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-093-33c5399677.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="1088"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">C．<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-094-e8855a4611.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="768" height="960">D．<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-095-51b5fc85db.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="576" height="960"></p>

<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】建立如图所示空间直角坐标系，则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-096-2bb877c2b7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="512">＝(0,2,0)，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-097-9fee39a605.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="512">＝(0,1,2)．</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-098-9a12523cc7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="827" height="703"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴cosθ＝<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-099-c96c040bdf.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1568" height="1408">＝<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-100-69227569d8.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1760" height="1152">.∴sinθ＝<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-101-06731fc821.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2944" height="992">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">故点A到直线BE的距离d＝|<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-102-88e723ced0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="512">|sinθ＝2×<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-103-f592998470.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2048" height="992">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">故答案为B</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【题组三 点面距】</p>
</div>

<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（1）证明：在直三棱柱<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-117-336cf051ee.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2208" height="576">中，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-118-ee6ae909ba.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2464" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-119-bbe13f6130.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2336" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-120-9fd69941b2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="416" height="416">为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-121-3e35dbcf65.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="448">的中点.所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-122-40a0059075.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3296" height="576">,因为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-123-f87d7575c3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2272" height="576">，所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-124-ca22851633.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="992" height="416">平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-125-3e5ab3b5c4.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1312" height="576">；</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">（2）因为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-126-6f7f33c388.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1234" height="458">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-127-9c4917bcdf.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1536" height="448">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-128-d0fa37a46e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2048" height="448">，由（1）可知<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-129-5b7156e7ac.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1632" height="448">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-130-d7f1eeb60e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="7360" height="992">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">即<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-131-59c7929710.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3008" height="448">，可得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-132-d4bf6d9c8f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2176" height="448">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-133-94d85b73b0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1568" height="448">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-134-c070be86e9.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="352" height="384">为原点建立如下图所示的空间直角坐标系：</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-135-254ba9d4d1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="233" height="201"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-136-f2b3ffa272.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="5152" height="1088">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-137-b95ce894ab.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="6848" height="1088">，</p>

<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】(1)<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-216-b25c574ceb.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1504" height="544">;(2)<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-217-5056bca1be.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1024" height="1088">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】(Ⅰ)∵平面ABD⊥平面ABC，且交线为AB，而AC⊥AB，∴AC⊥平面ABD.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又∵DE∥AC，∴DE⊥平面ABD，从而DE⊥BD.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">注意到BD⊥AE，且DE∩AE=E，∴BD⊥平面ADE，于是，BD⊥AD.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">而AD=BD=1，∴<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-218-9cc6feea1d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1504" height="544">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">(Ⅱ)∵AD=BD，取AB的中点为O，∴DO⊥AB.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又∵平面ABD⊥平面ABC，∴DO⊥平面ABC.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">过O作直线OY∥AC，以点O为坐标原点，直线OB，OY，OD分别为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-219-fed1e1433e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1344" height="416">轴，建立空间直角坐标系<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-220-be50ce733b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1248" height="512">，如图所示.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">记<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-221-b53e965775.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1440" height="448">，则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-222-b84b8494de.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1376" height="448">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-223-8c1cbaadb0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4448" height="1280">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-224-b017e15f5e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4704" height="1280">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-225-fb013c7046.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2304" height="1280">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-226-85a73847d7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2752" height="768">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-227-a00357b86a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3232" height="1280">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">令平面BCD的一个法向量为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-228-b0b7e5a431.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2240" height="640">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">由<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-229-6dd16681ba.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1824" height="1216">得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-230-3bc0776331.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3072" height="1792">.令<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-231-6af77abdac.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1184" height="544">，得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-232-77bd8c1366.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2560" height="1088">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又∵<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-233-6de588ff9d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2432" height="672">，∴点E到平面BCD的距离<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-234-f61bb3ac67.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3584" height="1728">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">∵<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-235-b84b8494de.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1376" height="448">，∴当<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-236-626db0621c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="448">时，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-237-60db2e4a3c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="352" height="448">取得最大值，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-238-aeb2424811.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3520" height="1664">.</p>

### 题 112｜原题 1

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-question">
<p class="local-docx-line">1．如图，在四棱锥O−ABCD中，底面ABCD是边长为2的正方形，OA⊥底面ABCD，OA=2，M，N，R分别为OA，BC，AD的中点，</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-q-082-6f9a208d61.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="320" height="314"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">求直线MN与平面OCD的距离及平面MNR与平面OCD的距离.</p>
</div>
:::

:::solution 查看解析版原文

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-answer">
<p class="local-docx-line">1．如图，在四棱锥O−ABCD中，底面ABCD是边长为2的正方形，OA⊥底面ABCD，OA=2，M，N，R分别为OA，BC，AD的中点，</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-335-6f9a208d61.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="320" height="314"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">求直线MN与平面OCD的距离及平面MNR与平面OCD的距离.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-336-52e0cf8d61.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="1088">；<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-337-52e0cf8d61.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="1088"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】因为M，R分别为AO，AD的中点，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以MR∥OD.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">在正方形ABCD中，N，R分别为BC，AD的中点，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以NR∥CD.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又MR∩NR=R，OD∩CD=D，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以平面MNR∥平面OCD.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">又MN<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-338-dcfd84c9ba.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="320">平面MNR，所以MN∥平面OCD.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以直线MN与平面OCD的距离、平面MNR与平面OCD的距离都等于点N到平面OCD的距离.以点A为坐标原点，建立如图所示的空间直角坐标系，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">则O(0，0，2)，C(2，2，0)，D(0，2，0)，N(2，1，0)，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-339-0c1c82eb5b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="544">=(0，1，0)，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-340-0d4aab55fa.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="544">=(0，2，−2)，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-341-0ae9c1c330.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="544">=(−2，0，0)，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">设平面OCD的法向量为n=(x，y，z)，则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-342-00de0f996d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3232" height="1216">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">令z=1，得n=(0，1，1)为平面OCD的一个法向量.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以点N到平面OCD的距离d=|<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-343-0c1c82eb5b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="544">·<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-344-b0db48610c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="512" height="1120">|=<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-345-bc039ea24f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="1088">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以直线MN与平面OCD的距离、平面MNR与平面OCD的距离都等于<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-346-bc039ea24f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="1088">.</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-347-0276a887c4.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="418" height="364"></div>
</div>
:::

:::

### 题 113｜原题 2

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-question">
<p class="local-docx-line">2．在底面是直角梯形的四棱锥P­ABCD中，侧棱PA⊥底面ABCD，BC∥AD，∠ABC＝90°，PA＝AB＝BC＝2，AD＝1，则AD到平面PBC的距离为________.</p>
</div>
:::

:::solution 查看解析版原文

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-answer">
<p class="local-docx-line">2．在底面是直角梯形的四棱锥P­ABCD中，侧棱PA⊥底面ABCD，BC∥AD，∠ABC＝90°，PA＝AB＝BC＝2，AD＝1，则AD到平面PBC的距离为________.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-348-fbe810a1e5.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="544"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】由已知AB，AD，AP两两垂直．</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-349-d70c9b6cc9.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="827" height="1033"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">∴以A为坐标原点，AB，AD，AP分别为x轴，y轴，z轴建立空间直角坐标系，则A(0,0,0)，B(2,0,0)，C(2,2,0)，P(0,0,2)，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-350-e9ea317ee0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="512">＝(2,0，－2)，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-351-ebaed88722.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="544">＝(0,2,0)．</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">设平面PBC的一个法向量为n＝(a，b，c)，则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-352-b0bb5959fb.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1984" height="1152">令a＝1，则n＝(1,0,1)．又<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-353-88e723ced0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="512">＝(2,0,0)，∴d＝<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-354-68796c73d7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1344" height="1184">＝<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-355-8c058981a3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="544"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">故答案为：<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp27-a-356-8c058981a3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="544"></p>
</div>
:::

<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】三棱锥的三条侧棱两两互相垂直，所以它的外接球就是它扩展为正方体的外接球，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">因为外接球的表面积是<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-066-4c22ced633.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="512" height="416">，所以球的半径为1，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以正方体的对角线的长为2，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">设侧棱长为a,则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-067-dbf87e4167.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="5440" height="1056">.所以侧棱长为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-068-65f84bfde6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="1088">．故选<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-069-eb51a000df.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="352" height="384">．</p>

:::solution 查看解析版原文

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-answer">
<p class="local-docx-line">1．（2020·黑龙江省哈尔滨三中高三二模（理））在边长为2的菱形<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-170-6d53f638bf.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="448">中，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-171-8a2816d8c3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1696" height="576">，将菱形<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-172-6d53f638bf.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="448">沿对角线<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-173-48c3e3062f.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="448">折起，使二面角<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-174-4d43c32e2d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1888" height="448">的大小为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-175-92e9e3c0c3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="608" height="512">，则所得三棱锥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-176-bc24379ed3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1504" height="448">的外接球表面积为（    ）</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">A．<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-177-4c22ced633.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="512" height="416">B．<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-178-a08f6c283a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="832" height="992">C．<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-179-cd5dcb108b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="544" height="448">D．<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-180-021e92f76a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="864" height="992"></p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】B</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【解析】由于四边形<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-181-6d53f638bf.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="448">是边长为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-182-df2592370d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="320" height="416">的菱形，且<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-183-8a2816d8c3.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1696" height="576">，则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-184-0b7eef4e04.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4864" height="608">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-185-9daa3bec08.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1088" height="448">、<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-186-2ae96b845d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1120" height="448">都是边长为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-187-df2592370d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="320" height="416">的等边三角形，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">由于菱形的对角线互相垂直，则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-188-7ba6bb645a.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1600" height="448">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-189-6349c66ded.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1632" height="448">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-190-9fa4efe311.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="416">为二面角<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-191-4d43c32e2d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1888" height="448">的平面角，即<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-192-b004dcc5d1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2048" height="512">，</p>
<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-193-42f9eb49b9.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="621" height="475"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">过点<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-194-eb51a000df.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="352" height="384">作平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-195-ba1294b6c8.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="928" height="448">的垂线<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-196-ffe0f2f888.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="384">，垂足为点<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-197-64f7601f67.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="512" height="416">，则点<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-198-64f7601f67.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="512" height="416">在线段<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-199-08e7e9023c.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="672" height="416">上，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">由<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-200-c0e8aeaf97.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2400" height="576">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-201-b004dcc5d1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2048" height="512">，可得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-202-bab9c001a9.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3840" height="1088">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">且<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-203-30281cd812.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1088" height="416">是等边三角形，所以，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-204-bed03eea0b.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2368" height="576">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">设<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-205-2ae96b845d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1120" height="448">的外心为点<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-206-e6b5ca216e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="416" height="448">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-207-a2632e2556.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">的中点<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-208-fd170d8011.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="416" height="384">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">在平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-209-78f9a0ac38.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="896" height="416">内，过点<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-210-e6b5ca216e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="416" height="448">、<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-211-fd170d8011.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="416" height="384">分别作平面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-212-ba1294b6c8.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="928" height="448">、<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-213-a2632e2556.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">的垂线交于点<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-214-ed7382d549.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="448">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">则点<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-215-ed7382d549.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="448">为三棱锥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-216-de1844290d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1536" height="448">的外接球的球心，则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-217-5ab32bec32.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3040" height="1088">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-218-5b422588f5.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2848" height="1088">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-219-1a2bcd0143.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2048" height="512">，则<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-220-bfe6e02622.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="7360" height="1120">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">由于<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-221-ed7382d549.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="448">、<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-222-e6b5ca216e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="416" height="448">、<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-223-9fd69941b2.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="416" height="416">、<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-224-fd170d8011.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="416" height="384">四点共圆，可得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-225-208e66c2f8.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3200" height="1088">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">所以，三棱锥<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-226-de1844290d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1536" height="448">的外接球的表面积为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-227-5da1b8ced1.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="3136" height="1344">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">故选：B.</p>

:::diagram
<div class="local-docx-card local-docx-answer">
<p class="local-docx-line">2．（2020·安徽省舒城中学）已知边长为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-228-2e8d623169.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="768" height="576">的菱形<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-229-6d53f638bf.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="448">中，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-230-e1b52b1077.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2016" height="512">，<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-231-a2632e2556.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="640" height="416">中点为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-232-ed7382d549.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="448">，将其沿对角线BD折叠使其变为<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-233-ee61e36ef8.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2208" height="512">的四面体<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-234-6d53f638bf.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1152" height="448">，则四面体的外接球的表面积为______</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">【答案】<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-235-9e9f896224.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="736" height="448"></p>

<p class="local-docx-line">所以<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-393-ee87657ed7.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1024" height="416">平面ABC，且<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-394-9c62ddbce6.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4480" height="736">.</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">设O为三棱锥P-ABC外接球的球心，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">连接<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-395-a426e620d0.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="736" height="576">，OP，OC，过O作<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-396-05665e251e.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1664" height="448">，垂足为D，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">则外接球的半径R满足<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-397-74d7cb0266.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="5504" height="608">，</p>

<div class="local-docx-figure"><img class="local-docx-image local-docx-block-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-498-e81e9cca90.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1176" height="1382"></div>
<p class="local-docx-line">由<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-499-3e20269e80.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="4000" height="512">，可知<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-500-bac9c56653.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="2144" height="512">，</p>
<p class="local-docx-line">则球心<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-501-15dc324189.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="384" height="448">在过<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-502-ad91b54204.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="736" height="416">中点<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-503-84e48e772d.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="512" height="448">与面<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-504-8da2766203.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="960" height="448">垂直的直线上，</p>

<p class="local-docx-line">可得<img class="local-docx-image local-docx-inline-image" src="../../../assets/solid-geometry-local/kp28-a-509-139a9d8125.png" alt="本地资料图片" width="1376" height="512">，</p>
